title: Ether ETFs extend outflow streak to nine days as Solana funds snap record 14-week inflow run
summary: Spot bitcoin, solana, and ether ETFs all logged weekly outflows following last week's trading, a notable shift for some of the funds.

title: Solana is about to halve its block times as final 200-millisecond upgrade nears
summary: The network is completing a seven-week push to produce blocks twice as frequently, though validators face higher costs and tighter operating windows.

title: Securitize stock jumps over 10% after launching tokenized US equities on Solana
summary: Securitize’s new offering gives eligible investors access to tokenized shares of 12 US companies, with dividend and voting rights and plans for round-the-clock trading.

title: Solana DeFi Firms Orca and Loopscale Merge Under New Formation Brand
summary: Solana DEX Orca and lending platform Loopscale will operate as Formation, a New York company aiming to finance AI, energy, robotics and defense assets and eventually reach regulated U.S. markets.

title: Decrypt Money Accounts on Solana to Power The Information Exchange
summary: One self-custodial platform to power Earn, Swaps, Predictions and Perps on Decrypt, as it builds out its financial and intelligence market.

title: Securitize Brings Nvidia, Apple and Amazon Onchain With Tokenized Stocks on Solana
summary: The new Securitize Stocks product launches with 12 names backed one-to-one by real shares—preserving dividends and voting rights—trading first on Solana, with NYSE and OKX-ICE venues planned.

title: Securitize launches 1:1-backed tokenized stocks, starting with Apple, Nvidia, Strategy and more
summary: Securitize launches tokenized US stocks on Solana, backed 1:1 by real shares with dividends and USDC settlement.

title: Samsung Wallet Taps Solana for USDC Transfers on 82M US Galaxy Devices
summary: Users can send USDC across borders from late October, three months after Samsung teased stablecoin support without naming a blockchain.
